d:
Bihar ke bahubli neta aur Mokama vidhayak Anant Singh ke ghar shadi ki shahnaee baj gaee hai. unki beti Shivangi Singh aur Rishikesh Kumar shadi ke bandhan men bandh gae hain. Nadwan sthit Anant Singh ke aavas par bhavy samaroh ke bich donon ne sat phere lekar ek-dusre ko jivansathi chuna.
Shivangi aur Rishikesh ki shadi ko lekar kaee dinon se taiyariyan chal rahi thin. ghurdaur pratiyogita se lekar VVIP mehmanon ke aagman tak, is shahi shadi ki khub charcha rahi. ab sat pheron ke sath Anant Singh ke parivar men shadi ki khushiyan puri ho gaee hain.
